mapper.sql: image.id AS image_id, image.task_id, task.task_no, task.task_status, meter.id AS meter_id, meter.meter_no, meter.meter_name, image.uploader_type, image.uploader_id, CASE image.uploader_type WHEN 'METER_READER' THEN reader.username WHEN 'DEVICE' THEN device.device_no END AS uploader_code, CASE image.uploader_type WHEN 'METER_READER' THEN reader.display_name WHEN 'DEVICE' THEN device.device_name END AS uploader_name, image.upload_request_id, image.image_type, image.original_name, image.bucket_name, image.object_key, image.oss_etag, image.content_type, image.file_size, image.image_width, image.image_height, image.sha256, image.image_status, image.storage_status, image.status_reason, image.status_changed_by, image.status_changed_at, image.deleted, image.deleted_by, image.deleted_at, result_image.result_id, image.version, image.created_at, image.updated_at

FROM meter_image AS image INNER JOIN meter_reading_task AS task ON task.id = image.task_id INNER JOIN meter ON meter.id = task.meter_id LEFT JOIN sys_user AS reader ON reader.id = image.uploader_id AND image.uploader_type = 'METER_READER' LEFT JOIN device ON device.id = image.uploader_id AND image.uploader_type = 'DEVICE' LEFT JOIN meter_reading_result_image AS result_image ON result_image.image_id = image.id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE image.task_id = #{taskId}
AND image.deleted = 0
ORDER BY image.created_at ASC, image.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE meter_image AS image INNER JOIN meter_reading_task AS task ON task.id = image.task_id SET image.deleted = 1, image.deleted_by = #{readerId}, image.deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, image.storage_status = 'DELETE_PENDING', image.version = image.version + 1 WHERE image.id = #{imageId} AND image.task_id = #{taskId} AND image.uploader_type = 'METER_READER' AND image.uploader_id = #{readerId} AND image.deleted = 0 AND image.version = #{version} AND task.task_status = 'PROCESSING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM meter_reading_result_image AS relation WHERE relation.image_id = image.id )
